name: Big Tent
why: Game-end bonus for spreading one member per color; steady planning, no big moment.

name: Sweet Nothings
why: You trade silver for double in colors you need and rivals get a gift.

name: Promote
why: Trading up a member is a neat move; the rival gets a member back, so the sting is mild.

name: Hoarder
why: One-time convert to white sets up Cash In; useful but flat on its own.

name: Regular
why: Small blue drip when you buy followers; fine, quiet.

name: Stash
why: Resources plus a follower if you recruit; solid, unremarkable.

name: Gather
why: Red plus a follower on recruit; a plain good turn.

name: Money Changers
why: White trickle when anyone buys followers; fine passive.

name: Build Up
why: Plain green income that grows by round; fine.

name: Kidnapper
why: Takes a member from the same rival at recruit and every round start; that rival is singled out and keeps losing members before round III.

name: Tourist
why: Round-start follower burst for holding many colors feels rewarding each round.

name: Shopaholics
why: Recruiting twice every turn is a big engine the owner enjoys.

name: Sleep In
why: Big purple haul with the last-minion edge; a satisfying round I pick.

name: Polish
why: Silver into any colors; handy conversion, no thrill.

name: Splurge
why: Buying a pricey member and getting a pile of followers is a fun payoff turn.

name: Timekeeper
why: Game-end count of purple members; fine.

name: Recluse
why: Catch-up bonus for staying small; fine and a bit odd to aim for.

name: Gardeners
why: Fills in missing colors; helpful, quiet.

name: Encore
why: Doubling a strong On Recruit is a big combo moment.

name: Anarchist
why: Swapping members around is clever; the victim gets a similar-cost member back, so it stings only a little.

name: Allowance
why: White plus a follower on recruit; plain.

name: Caravan
why: One of each color you hold every round start feels like a growing engine.

name: Volunteer
why: A cheap vanilla follower; fine filler.

name: Foster Parents
why: Pays when members move to you from rivals; situational but fine.

name: Recruit Twice
why: Two recruits in one turn is a strong, fun turn.

name: Cover
why: Copying an empty action is flexible; fine.

name: Harvest
why: Choose-your-colors income; useful, plain.

name: Cash In
why: Turning a stockpile of white into a big follower jump is a payoff moment.

name: Wallflower
why: Doubling copied resources makes Green copies feel huge.

name: Roadie
why: Green income that scales with green members; fine.

name: Gossip
why: Followers from every skip makes Hold Up and Bouncers turns gleeful.

name: Smooth Talkers
why: Silver pays for any color; convenient, not exciting.

name: Peek
why: Arranging the pile and picking from it is tidy control; fine.

name: Makeover
why: Rearranging resources is useful flexibility; fine.

name: Toastmaster
why: Follower each Silver space; fine drip.

name: Alchemists
why: Resources count as any for recruiting; convenient, quiet.

name: Shift Crew
why: Vanilla 4 followers; fine.

name: Desperado
why: Bigger steals while behind; a catch-up tool, fine.

name: Recruiter
why: Red refund on recruits; fine.

name: Snobs
why: Game-end count of blue members; fine.

name: Heiresses
why: One-time white burst by member count; fine.

name: Patroness
why: Follower when shop members go under; fine with Blue combos.

name: Caterer
why: Silver when silver is gifted; small passive.

name: Critic
why: Follower when rivals recruit blue; fine.

name: Impressionist
why: Resource when anyone copies; small passive.

name: Extra Hand
why: An extra minion for a round is a strong, felt moment.

name: Patriarch
why: Game-end follower per 2 members; fine.

name: Envy
why: Round-start silver top-up to match the leader; fine catch-up.

name: Misers
why: Game-end followers for hoarded white; fine.

name: Brokers
why: Extra follower on White payoffs; fine.

name: Exchange
why: Small resource-to-follower conversion; fine.

name: Out of Style
why: Clearing a color from the shop for blue; useful, mild.

name: New Blood
why: Bonus for a new color recruit; fine.

name: Drifters
why: Choose its color for contests or sets; flexible, quiet.

name: Dyer
why: Yellow per color held; fine income.

name: Cashier
why: Recruit it and cash all white into followers at once; a fun payoff.

name: Clerk
why: One red per round; fine but dull.

name: Doppelganger
why: Becoming a copy of your best member is a satisfying trick.

name: Stunt Double
why: Repeats the action you just took; good on strong turns, fine.

name: Dabblers
why: Two wild members for contests; fine.

name: Reprise
why: Copy a taken action; flexible, fine.

name: Old Money
why: Game-end count of white members; fine.

name: Shake Down
why: The victim chooses their own punishment: pay up or lose a member, before round III.

name: Bell Ringer
why: The trigger is so tangled nobody can plan for it, and the reward is 1 purple; no fun to own.

name: Greatest Hits
why: Replaying every On Recruit in round III is a big finale.

name: Jack-of-All-Trades
why: Yellow as wild in sets; fine.

name: Courier
why: Resources on consecutive turns; fine with purple turn tricks.

name: Estate Sale
why: Cash out a member for white; fine.

name: Landlord
why: Steady white income; fine.

name: Proselytizers
why: Follower on every recruit; solid, quiet.

name: Hold Up
why: Skipping the next turn stings, but it hits whoever is next, not a chosen victim, and it is just one turn.

name: Party Gifts
why: Owner scores followers by giving rivals silver; a gift to the table.

name: Harmonist
why: Game-end follower per full set; fine.

name: Busker
why: Steady green income; fine.

name: Melting Pot
why: Resources per member color; fine.

name: Hawker
why: Auctioning a shop member to rivals is a fun moment and every outcome is fair.
